title: FINAL FANTASY VIII Remastered
description: The classic Squall and Rinoa RPG returns with remastered character visuals and convenience features such as Battle Assist, x3 speed, and an option to disable random encounters. Squall trains at Balamb Garden and begins military missions with other students. The game culminates in a surreal late-game confrontation shaped by the sorceress storyline.

gameplayPillars.title: Junction system
gameplayPillars.description: Guardian Forces and magic can be junctioned to character stats, creating a highly flexible but unusual progression system.

gameplayPillars.title: Active Time Battle combat
gameplayPillars.description: Classic command-based encounters use ATB timing, Limit Breaks, Guardian Forces, and draw/cast mechanics.

gameplayPillars.title: Triple Triad
gameplayPillars.description: The famous card minigame is deeply integrated into side content and can influence item/magic progression.

gameplayPillars.title: Remaster boosters
gameplayPillars.description: Battle Assist, x3 speed, and no-random-encounter options reduce friction for modern replay.

gameplayPillars.title: Story-driven world tour
gameplayPillars.description: The adventure moves from military school drama into global conflict, romance, and increasingly surreal events.
